summary: The contents of the retrieved documents detail the implementation of the ConfirmedEditAll user control within a web application, which is used for managing enrollment records. It includes methods for setting parameters, handling commands, and validating user input.
purpose: The ConfirmedEditAll user control is designed to facilitate the editing and confirmation of enrollments in a grid format within a web-based user interface. It allows users to view, edit, and apply batch actions to enrollment records.

workflows.name: Edit Enrollment
steps: Set up input parameters using UserSession.
Load enrollment data to be edited.
Check if the screen is editable based on enrollment data conditions.
Provide options to cancel or save changes.
Handle batch editing and saving through grid commands.

business_rules: Screen is editable if enrollment is not waived, graduated, or inactive unless set to read-only.
Hide 'Save All' button if in 'Add' or 'Edit' mode.
Redirect to 'EnrollmentEditAll.aspx' for continuation after saving edits.
validations: Check if UserSession is available before proceeding with data selection.
Ensure data fields like Shift Length are correctly set before allowing further actions.
Limit text input lengths to specified maximums.
calculations: Calculate shifts based on the duration and shift length.
conditions: Data row visibility is dependent on the ScreenIsEditable boolean.
Hide header Save buttons if grid has less than 14 rows or is not in page size limit.
system_behavior: Disable edit fields if read-only is set.
Bind data to grid on certain conditions.
JavaScript functions are set dynamically based on grid state.
dependencies: Employs ASP.NET controls like GridView for UI rendering.
exceptions: Cancel data selection if UserSession is not set.
